evidence: Modifies libbitcoinkernel callback dispatching in bitcoinkernel.cpp/h, kernel wrapper, and test_kernel.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a deadlock where libbitcoinkernel applications hang if their log callback re-entrantly logs or triggers garbage collection that destroys logging objects. The PR notes that without this fix, Python garbage collection destroying a chainstate manager during callbacks causes hangs, as demonstrated by the new hanging test cases.
